faceLift.heroSubtitle: Surgical Facial Rejuvenation for Natural, Long-Lasting Results
faceLift.heroDesc1: Ageing of the face is not caused by skin laxity alone. Over time, gravity, volume loss, and weakening of deeper facial support structures lead to sagging of the cheeks, jowls, jawline, and neck.
faceLift.heroDesc2: A face lift, medically known as rhytidectomy, is a surgical procedure designed to reposition deeper tissues, remove excess skin, and restore a more youthful yet natural facial contour. When performed by a certified plastic surgeon with anatomical expertise, a face lift delivers long-lasting rejuvenation without the "over-pulled" look.
faceLift.whatIsDesc1: A face lift is a surgical procedure that improves visible signs of ageing in the lower face and midface. It does not stop ageing, but it resets the facial structure to a younger baseline.
faceLift.whatIsDesc2: Evidence-based surgical literature confirms that deep-plane and SMAS-based face lift techniques produce more natural and durable results than skin-only lifts.
faceLift.howItWorksDesc: Modern face lift surgery focuses on structural repositioning, not skin tension. The surgery is performed under general anaesthesia in a hospital setting.
faceLift.step0: Discreet incisions around the hairline and ears
faceLift.step1: Elevation and repositioning of deeper facial layers
faceLift.step2: Removal of excess skin without over-tightening
faceLift.step3: Careful closure to minimise visible scarring
faceLift.howItWorksNote: International clinical authorities such as the Mayo Clinic and the American Society of Plastic Surgeons recognise modern face lift techniques as effective, safe, and predictable.
faceLift.typesDesc: The surgical approach is chosen based on anatomy, ageing pattern, and expectations.
faceLift.type0Desc: Addresses midface, lower face, and jawline laxity for comprehensive facial rejuvenation.
faceLift.type1Desc: Targets early jowls and mild sagging with smaller incisions and shorter recovery.
faceLift.type2Desc: Repositions deeper support structures for longer-lasting, natural outcomes.
faceLift.type3Desc: Combines facial and neck rejuvenation for comprehensive balance and harmony.
faceLift.benefitsDesc: A well-executed face lift makes the face look refreshed — not altered.
faceLift.benefit2: Long-lasting results compared to non-surgical treatments
faceLift.benefit4: Can be combined with eyelid surgery or fat transfer
faceLift.candidateDesc: Ideal candidates typically meet the following criteria. Suitability is confirmed during a detailed consultation.
faceLift.candidate0: Have moderate to significant facial sagging
faceLift.candidate2: Do not smoke or can stop temporarily
faceLift.candidate4: Prefer long-term correction over temporary treatments
faceLift.recoveryNote: Postoperative care aligns with international surgical safety and wound-care principles outlined by the World Health Organization.
faceLift.comparisonDesc: Non-surgical treatments can complement — but not replace — surgical lifting.
faceLift.pricingDesc: Face lift surgery cost varies depending on:
faceLift.pricing0: Type of face lift technique selected
faceLift.faqDesc: Get answers to common concerns about face lift surgery
faceLift.faq0A: A face lift is surgery that repositions facial tissues and removes excess skin to restore a youthful appearance.
faceLift.faq1Q: Will a face lift look unnatural?
faceLift.faq1A: No, when performed using modern techniques, results are natural and balanced.
faceLift.faq2Q: How long do face lift results last?
faceLift.faq2A: Typically 8–12 years, depending on ageing and lifestyle factors.
faceLift.faq3A: Discomfort is usually mild to moderate and well controlled with medication.
faceLift.faq4A: Scars are placed along natural creases and hairlines, making them discreet.
faceLift.faq5Q: How long is recovery after a face lift?
faceLift.faq5A: Most patients return to normal activities within 2–3 weeks.
faceLift.faq6Q: Can a face lift be combined with other procedures?
faceLift.faq6A: Yes, commonly with eyelid surgery, fat transfer, or neck lift.
faceLift.faq7Q: Is face lift surgery safe in Malaysia?
faceLift.faq7A: Yes, when performed by a certified plastic surgeon in a licensed facility.
faceLift.ctaDesc1: Restore facial balance, confidence, and youthful definition with surgeon-performed face lift surgery in Malaysia.
faceLift.ctaDesc2: A face lift is one of the most transformative procedures in facial rejuvenation — delivering long-lasting results that non-surgical treatments simply cannot match. The goal is not to change who you are, but to restore what time has taken away.
